searchText: MSRP $252,672. New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Indigo CC35 Model. Features Frameless Dual Pane Windows Solar Charging System More About This RV This RV measures approximately 37 feet in length and features a Ford F-53 chassis with a 7.3L V-8 engine, a six speed automatic transmission, a drop-down overhead loft, 2 slide-outs and a bedroom TV.
